title: Gappy probabilistic manifold decomposition for nonlinear field reconstruction
summary: This paper proposes gappy probabilistic manifold decomposition (Gappy PMD), a nonlinear method for reconstructing high-dimensional fields from extremely sparse measurements. Gappy PMD reconstructs the field on the nonlinear manifold learned by probabilistic manifold decomposition (PMD). We further propose a differentiable point selection method for reduced-order model (ROM)-based field reconstruction (DPS).
